scope: AL root authority and canon-boundary audit

findings.claim: The AL repository root authority is _truth/receipts/index.json.
The README declares the public proof surface and receipt viewer.
A claim is public only when the receipt is present, indexed, and replay-linked.
Committed GitHub files are public artifacts, but they are not canonical AL receipts unless indexed and replay-linked through _truth/receipts/index.json.
OpenAI epoch-chain artifacts remain experimental public files until explicitly indexed and replay-linked by AL root authority.
